item.title: The Great Gatsby is the most misunderstood novel (2021)
item.description:
📝 'No one had the slightest idea what the book was about': Why The Great Gatsby is the world's most misunderstood novel10 April 2025ShareSaveHephzibah AndersonShareSaveAlamyThe Great Gatsby is synonymous with parties, glitz and glamour – but this is just one of many misunderstandings about the book that began with its first publication a century ago, in April 1925. It's now possible to lounge on a Gatsby sofa, check in at the Gatsby hotel, even chow down on a Gatsby sandwich – essentially a supersize, souped-up chip butty. It's since become such a potent force in pop culture that even those who've never read it feel as if they have, helped along, of course, by Hollywood.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20210209-the-worlds-most-misunderstood-novel
